children: Oil futures fall in early Asian trade on a possible technical correction after futures posted strong gains last Friday. However, futures' decline may be limited by geopolitical tensions that could lead to supply disruptions. Ukrainian drones unleashed early Sunday the largest attack on St. Petersburg since the start of the Russia-Ukraine war, hitting a major oil terminal and other critical targets. "The market is also wary of another escalation in hostilities in the Middle East," ANZ Research analysts say in a research report. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 0.6% lower at $100.80 per barrel; front-month Brent crude oil futures are 1.4% lower at $108.29 a barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
